purpose: One independent mechanical test coupon; not a full doll.

materials.first_choice: Bambu Lab PLA-CF, black preferred, same spool/batch for all three parts
fallback_order: ordinary unfilled PLA with named brand and product
ordinary PETG with named brand and product
materials.fallback_condition: Supplier cannot provide the prior choice. Label the entire set and use the actual material profile. Do not mix materials within one set.
materials.unknown_brand_CF: Not equivalent by name alone. Do not automatically use the Bambu 0.4 mm recipe for another filled filament.

machine.for_CF: Verify hardened steel 0.4 mm nozzle and an extrusion path/gears suitable for abrasive filament. Model name alone does not establish installed hardware.

process.brim: 5 mm outer brim starting point if needed; avoid internal-hole brims
process.speed_note: Project trial caps, not a validated optimum. Preserve lower cooling/volumetric limits and supplier calibration.
process.flow_line_width_retraction: Use material/machine preset and documented calibration.
process.support: Slice and inspect first. Keep the provided bed-facing faces. Add local removable support only where needed; no inaccessible fused support in nut or washer pockets.
process.postprocess: Remove support and burrs only; no geometry rescaling, through-drilling stepped bores, polishing friction faces, coating or annealing.

official_profile_reference_observed_2026.applies_only_to: Bambu PLA-CF with 0.4 mm nozzle and Smooth/High Temperature PEI or Textured PEI plate
official_profile_reference_observed_2026.cooling: Use selected machine PLA-CF preset; do not give A1 and P1S one universal fan setting.
official_profile_reference_observed_2026.different_material_or_plate: Use the matching current official/supplier-tested preset and record the change.
official_profile_reference_observed_2026.drying: Use current material instructions appropriate to the dryer; record conditions.

orientation.base_halves: Split mating face toward bed, as supplied in 3MF.
orientation.lever: Flat as supplied; do not stand on its long edge.
orientation.allowed_rearrangement: XY translation and rotation about printer Z only; preserve bed-facing faces.

acceptance: Supplier reports actual dimensions/visible defects; these are CAD nominal values, not unverified printer tolerance promises. Owner performs actual metal fit and load tests.
mass_scope: Solid CAD estimate; excludes supports, brim, purge and process variation.
